svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: instagram-autopilot pipeline
svg.desc: instagram-autopilot pipeline. 23 components in 4 groups. Connections: Instagram Post to Claim the slot (slot due or create one); Claim the slot to autopilot-state (2/day cap, 180 min gap); Claim the slot to Fetch evidence; Evidence sources to Fetch evidence (titles + excerpts); Fetch evidence to Amazon Bedrock (evidence); Amazon Bedrock to Grounding gate (scene + caption); Grounding gate to SMIL SVG; Grounding gate to Kokoro narration; SMIL SVG to Headless Chrome; Headless Chrome to ffmpeg (frames); Kokoro narration to ffmpeg (voice clips); ffmpeg to ffprobe check; ffprobe check to Upload and publish; Upload and publish to Cloudinary (upload MP4); Upload and publish to Composio (container, status, publish); Upload and publish to autopilot-state (checkpoint, then receipt); Composio to Instagram (Graph API); Cloudinary to Instagram (fetches video_url).

text.tspan: One run per due slot or ask, at most one Reel. Every number on screen must appear in the fetched sources.
